2	
3	w2m runs Windows x64 programs on macOS. It translates the program's x86-64 code and runs it inside
4	a virtual machine on Apple silicon. The program's kernel32 imports are served by a "guest
5	runtime": freestanding C compiled for AArch64 with clang --target=arm64-apple-macos14 -O2 -std=c11 -Wall -Werror -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -fno-stack-protector -fno-exceptions -fno-unwind-tables -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables -mgeneral-regs-only, linked into the VM. There is no
6	C library: no memcpy, no memset, no headers but "runtime.h" (read it: it defines u64, u32 and u8
7	and nothing else). Arguments arrive per the Microsoft x64 calling convention: the first four in
8	the C parameters, and `rsp` is the guest stack pointer at the call, so the fifth argument is at
9	*(u64 *)(rsp + 0x28), the sixth at rsp + 0x30, the seventh at rsp + 0x38. Guest pointers can be
10	dereferenced directly. Each function's return value goes to RAX.
11	
12	Write `file.c` in this directory, defining exactly these functions:
13	
14	  u64 k32_CreateFileW(u64 name, u64 desired_access, u64 share_mode, u64 security_attributes, u64 rsp);
15	      creation disposition at rsp+0x28 (u32), flags and attributes at rsp+0x30 (u32), template at rsp+0x38
16	  u64 k32_CloseHandle(u64 handle);
17	  u64 k32_DeleteFileW(u64 name);
18	  u64 k32_ReadFile(u64 handle, u64 buffer, u64 count, u64 bytes_read, u64 rsp);   overlapped at rsp+0x28
19	  u64 k32_SetFilePointerEx(u64 handle, u64 distance, u64 new_pointer, u64 move_method);
20	  u64 w2m_file_write(u64 handle, u64 buffer, u64 count, u64 written);
21	      WriteFile on a non-stdout handle; runtime.c has already set *(u32 *)written = 0 and checked
22	      that `written` is not NULL and lpOverlapped is NULL; return 1 on success, 0 on failure
23	
24	The last-error code is w2m_teb()->last_error_value. Reach the Mac only through
25	w2m_host(op, a0, a1, a2, a3, &second) with the W2M_FILE_* primitives (host_file_primitives.md).
26	Return from each k32_ function through w2m_logged(W2M_API_<name>, arg0, return_value), which
27	records the call and returns its third argument. Call w2m_unimplemented(W2M_API_<name>, detail)
28	for an argument form you do not support; it stops the run. Handle values must not be 0x74
29	(standard output).
30	
31	The judge runs create_file.c, compiled by Windows's clang, in w2m over your file.c. Its output
32	must equal the rows in contract.json exactly, row for row and field for field. Those rows are
33	what Windows Server 2025 and 2022 printed.
34	
35	Files here: runtime.h, create_file.c (the probe), contract.json, host_file_primitives.md.
36	Tools: `build` compiles file.c and returns the compiler's errors or "built"; `judge` runs the probe
37	over file.c and returns the rows that differ, or the item run's verdict once every row is equal.
38	Work until `judge` reports the item run accepted, then answer with one line saying so.

1	file_bridge.py — the host side of the guest runtime's file system (Sprint 042).
2	
3	The guest runtime (`tools/guest_runtime/file.c`) implements the Windows file calls: dispositions,
4	sharing, error codes, name rules, file positions. It reaches the Mac only through the primitives
5	here, on the transport page (hvc #8), all under one root directory per run that stands in for the
6	guest's working directory:
7	
8	    FILE_LOOKUP  (path, chars)          -> kind: 0 absent, 1 file, 2 directory, 3 a directory on the way is missing;
9	                                           arg[5] the file id (inode) for 1 and 2
10	    FILE_OPEN    (path, chars, create)  -> host descriptor, or -errno; create=1 is O_CREAT|O_EXCL; arg[5] the file id
11	    FILE_CLOSE   (fd)                   -> 0
12	    FILE_READ    (fd, buffer, n, offset)-> bytes read (pread)
13	    FILE_WRITE   (fd, buffer, n, offset)-> bytes written (pwrite)
14	    FILE_SIZE    (fd)                   -> size
15	    FILE_TRUNCATE(fd, size)             -> 0
16	    FILE_UNLINK  (path, chars)          -> 0, or -errno
17	
18	Paths arrive as UTF-16LE as the guest normalized them. Components compare ASCII case-folded, as
19	NTFS compares ASCII names (its upcase table; non-ASCII folding is not needed by any recorded row
20	and is not done). An absolute path, a drive letter or a component that leaves the root is
21	Unimplemented: the run stops rather than guess.
